targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS time,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS unique_users
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  concat(device_mobile_brand_name, ' ', device_mobile_model_name) AS device,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND device_mobile_brand_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY device
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  concat(device_operating_system, ' ', device_operating_system_version) AS os_version,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND device_operating_system IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY os_version
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH active_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
    AND param_engagement_time_msec > 60000
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
), events AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    count() as count
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = '${event_name}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT
  active_users.event_date AS time,
  sum(ifNull(events.count, 0)) / uniqExact(active_users.user_pseudo_id) AS events_per_user
FROM active_users
LEFT JOIN events ON active_users.event_date = events.event_date
  AND active_users.user_pseudo_id = events.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY active_users.event_date
ORDER BY active_users.event_date

WITH all_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND param_ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
), events AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id,
    count() as count
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = '${event_name}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id
)
SELECT
  all_sessions.event_date AS time,
  sum(ifNull(events.count, 0)) / uniqExact(all_sessions.user_pseudo_id, all_sessions.param_ga_session_id) AS events_per_session
FROM all_sessions
LEFT JOIN events ON all_sessions.event_date = events.event_date
  AND all_sessions.user_pseudo_id = events.user_pseudo_id
  AND all_sessions.param_ga_session_id = events.param_ga_session_id
GROUP BY all_sessions.event_date
ORDER BY all_sessions.event_date

WITH active_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
    AND param_engagement_time_msec > 60000
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
), events AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id,
    count() as count
  FROM analytics_events
  WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND event_name = '${event_name}'
    AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
    AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  GROUP BY event_date, user_pseudo_id, param_ga_session_id
)
SELECT
  active_sessions.event_date AS time,
  sum(ifNull(events.count, 0)) / uniqExact(active_sessions.user_pseudo_id, active_sessions.param_ga_session_id) AS events_per_active_session
FROM active_sessions
LEFT JOIN events ON active_sessions.event_date = events.event_date
  AND active_sessions.user_pseudo_id = events.user_pseudo_id
  AND active_sessions.param_ga_session_id = events.param_ga_session_id
GROUP BY active_sessions.event_date
ORDER BY active_sessions.event_date
